evidence: 2026-08-20T11:23:50Z|Declining — the reload fallback is deliberately keyed off toInsert.length===0 regardless of *why* it's empty. Whether this run found nothing, or found candidates that got filtered out as irrelevant/outlier/duplicate, both cases mean 'no fresh usable evidence this run', and the fallback's whole purpose (ai-listings-drz) is to never let step3 null out suggested_price_cents when it has any real evidence at all, from any run. Narrowing the trigger to 'literal fetcher failure only' would reintroduce a version of the drz bug for the filtered-to-zero case: a listing whose comps all get legitimately outliered this run would still land at null price / 20% confidence, which is exactly the state this block exists to prevent. The staleness risk you're pointing at is real but orthogonal — that's what the dedup/outlier-on-reload and reload-limit fixes in 909ef2b address instead.
